verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an agentic commerce payments product, but nothing in the pack documents tagging orders with the originating AI agent or platform, or reporting and filtering transactions by agent. Store Sync says orders reach the merchant's order management system "just as it would from any other channel," and the toolkit's generic transaction-detail access has no documented per-agent dimension. Neither counts as agent attribution.

support.subject: As a merchant, orders are attributed to the originating agent and I can report on or filter transactions by agent
